role: Senior Software Engineer, through Mindgrub Technologies
dek: Under Armour was the most complex system I have worked in. The shopping experience sat inside a web of Jenkins build systems and CI automation from before CI was a common word, with layers of approvals and dynamic environments spun up to unit test new features against the latest builds. Alongside it I built the NEXT event application in Laravel for the USA and Canada.
